parties.respondent: The Regional Manager, Central Bank of India, and Others

summary: Constitutional validity of Income Tax Act s.17(2)(viii) and Rule 3(7)(i) challenged against excessive delegation and Article 14 violation; SBI's PLR benchmark contested; court upholds provisions as valid exercise of legislative policy discretion; delegation not unguided; classification sustained; appeals dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Income Tax Act, 1961 s.17(2)(viii), s.15, s.16, s.17
Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) functions
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; vires of challenged provisions upheld.
